pr_title: ddl: use session begin timestamp to read record for adding index (#43639)
pr_body:
This is an automated cherry-pick of #43639

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #40074

Problem Summary:

Previously, we use `store.CurrentVersion` to get the latest start TS to read table records. This is problematic because it does not take the GC life time into account.

### What is changed and how it works?

Get an internal session and begin transaction explicitly. Thus, we can utilize the mechanism introduced in #42897 to block the progress of GC safe point before the reading is complete.

issue_context.title: GC life time is shorter than transaction duration while running DDL
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

1. Run add index job in a large table, and set the batch_size to 10240.

It is not easy to reproduce because the DDL txn is usually fast.

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

No error.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

Ingest add index job fallback to txn-merge mode. 
```
[INFO] [index.go:762] ["[ddl] fallback to txn-merge backfill process"] [error="[tikv:9006]GC life time is shorter than transaction duration, transaction starts at 2022-12-20 10:58:20.94 +0000 UTC, GC safe point is 2022-12-20 10:58:22.14 +0000 UTC"]
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

ed33fdea6
comments:
The problem still exist in b51758efdbd97:

```
[2023/05/08 07:34:36.517 +00:00] [ERROR] [backfilling_scheduler.go:461] ["[ddl-ingest] encounter error when handle index chunk"] [id=10736] [error="[tikv:9006]GC life time is shorter than transaction duration, transaction starts at 2023-05-08 07:17:32.674 +0000 UTC, GC safe point is 2023-05-08 07:19:07.624 +0000 UTC"]
```

review_comments: Could we use `CurrentTimestamp` to get the latest TS is instead of this logic?
